_note: Curated. Source: communitydragon/tristana.bin.json mSpellCalculations, damage TYPES verified against wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Tristana infobox 'damagetype' fields (the BIN never exposes type, and the auto-picker had W/R wrongly tagged Physical -- both are Magic per the wiki).
_noteQ: Rapid Fire: pure attack-speed steroid, no mSpellCalculations at all -- correctly no damage.
_noteW: Rocket Jump: LandingDamage = BaseDamage + bonusAD*ADRatio + AP*APRatio. Wiki confirms MAGIC damage ('deals magic damage to nearby enemies' on landing). Single AoE hit on landing.
_noteE: Explosive Charge has two distinct damage components confirmed by wiki: the ACTIVE detonation (ActiveDamage = ActiveBaseDamage + 0.8*bonusAD + 0.5*AP) is PHYSICAL ('the charge then detonates, dealing physical damage') -- curated as the main E hit, count 1, at the conservative un-stacked/no-crit-bonus reading (ActiveMaxDamage's +25%-per-stack-up-to-4 and the separate 40%-crit-chance amp are both conditional on stack count / crit chance, omitted per P2 conservative-undercount convention). The PASSIVE mine-kill explosion (PassiveDamage = PassiveBaseDamage + 0.25*AP) is MAGIC and only triggers if a marked target is killed by the attack that detonates it -- curated as an onHit bonusEffect (approximation of a kill-conditional proc, same style as Twitch P / Mordekaiser P in this codebase) rather than a guaranteed main-slot hit.
_noteR: Buster Shot: DamageCalc = BaseDamage + 0.7*bonusAD + AP*APRatio. Wiki confirms MAGIC damage (corrects the auto-picker's wrong Physical tag). Single hit + knockback.
